name: Sneak Attack
description: If the Goblin attacks a target that has already been attacked this round, it deals an additional 1d6 damage.

name: Infectious Bite
description: A target bitten by this creature must succeed on a MIND check (TN 14) at the start of their next turn or become Infected. Infected targets lose 2 HP at the start of each subsequent turn until cured.

name: Incorporeal
description: Physical damage dealt to this creature is reduced by half (rounded down). This trait increases the creature's effective DL by 2.

name: Shadow Grasp
description: The creature reaches into a target's shadow. The target is Immobilized until the end of their next turn.

name: Undying
description: When this creature would be reduced to 0 HP, it instead drops to 1 HP once per encounter. This ability does not trigger if the killing blow was dealt with radiant or holy damage.

name: Gaze of the Night
description: The creature locks eyes with a target within 10 squares. The target must succeed on a MIND check (TN 20) or be Charmed until the end of their next turn. A Charmed target cannot attack this creature and must move toward it on their turn.

name: Blood Drain
description: Melee attack against a grabbed target. On hit, deals damage as normal and this creature heals HP equal to half the damage dealt.
